meta.title: QQ Whale (Agent Presets + Mode + Panel)
meta.description: Turns a QQ alternate account into a chat persona inside DeepSeek Harness: two presets (qq-chat for single chats, qq-chat-v2 for group simulation), a tool guard that only lets QQ bridge tools through, and a qq-mode settings namespace controlling the bridge mode and admin. Also ships a seven-section "little whale" panel: life switch with dropout watchdog (auto-restart, wake tuning, quiet hours, lid-close keep-awake), cost & model (today's spend, current model, switch model and reasoning effort, lock default model), run mode, stickers and voice, sessions, persona cards, and eyes (read real chat logs and images, reply in place, save images into the sticker library).
